exposure: free fluid volume 4 h after surgery
Volume of blood loss during cesarean
volume of blood loss during cesarean
outcome: Volume of free fluid at 4 and 24 hours after cesarean
finding: The volume of free fluid in the abdomino-pelvic cavity after cesarean section was significantly associated with the volume of blood loss during the procedure at 4 hours but not 24 hours post-surgery.
mod_finding: This study, which examined risk factors for abdomino-pelvic free fluid after cesarean section, did not examine mode of delivery as a variable.
